segments.text: Surya Vigyan Part 1 – Understanding Past Lives, Siddhis & Rebirth
What is Surya Vigyan?

Surya Vigyan is a spiritual science that explains how our past lives, astral bodies, and spiritual powers (Siddhis) are connected. To understand this, we must first learn about the astral body (suksham sharir)– a spiritual form of ourselves that exists beyond the physical body.
How Our Past Lives Affect Us?
Let’s take an example:
A person named X lived in Ashaeiynn and practiced mantra chanting and sadhana. After he died, his master astral body stayed in Ashaeiynn with Gurudev, while his soul merged with the supreme soul.
X was reborn as Y, a cricketer, and spent his life playing cricket before passing away.

In his next life, he was reborn as Z. At the age of 15, he felt a strong attraction to Ashaeiynn, even though he had never been there before. This happened because his master astral body was still connected to Ashaeiynn and pulled him back to it.
This example shows that our past lives influence us, even if we don’t remember them. Our astral bodies from previous lives continue to exist and impact our present and future lives.
How Many Astral Bodies Do We Have?

Every time a person is reborn, a new astral body is created. If a person has lived 100 lives, they will have 100 astral bodies. These astral bodies remain behind the physical body, and their presence is recorded in different spiritual realms (loks) like Teh Lok.
Three Positions of Astral Bodies
There are three positions where an astral body can exist, each lasting for a different period:
First Position – Lasts 3-4 days.
Second Position – Lasts from 4 days to 4 months.
Third Position – Lasts from 4 months to 40 years.
The astral bodies keep changing, but their positions remain the same.
How to Gain Spiritual Powers (Siddhis) from Past Lives
Gurudev taught that if a person resists their past astral body four times in the first position, they will gain spiritual powers (Siddhis) from their past four lives in the third position.

Resisting an Astral Body means choosing spirituality over past habits. For example, if someone was a cricketer in a past life, their astral body might make them want to play cricket for four hours daily. But if they choose to play for only one hour and spend the rest of the time in devotion, they slowly weaken that past life’s influence. By resisting four different astral bodies, they gain the Siddhis of those past lives for 4 to 40 years.
This process is also linked to Kundalini Shakti, which helps bring forward past-life spiritual powers.
Supreme Astral Body and Lord Hanuman

After three generations, a person’s astral body (suksham sharir) meets his Supreme Astral (Mahasuksham Sharir) Body, which holds all their past life energies. When this happens, any wish they make will be fulfilled under the presence of Lord Hanuman.

For example, if a person has taken 1000 births, he will have 1000 astral bodies. Our Bhaiya ji, whom we pray to for conveying our wishes to Gurudev, is none other than our own supreme astral body. It means those who all are members of Ashaeiynn are astral bodies of bhaiya & we didn’t come to ashaeiynn by ourselves, it is our Supreme astral body of Bhaiya who attracted us towards ashaeiynn.
Why Does Bhaiya Ji Help Us?

Even though Bhaiya Ji is close to Gurudev, he still helps others. This is because, in his past human life, we were his Supreme Astral Body. At that time, he needed Tattvas & Pran Urja (spiritual energies) to achieve his goal. Now that we are in human bodies and have access to these energies, he helps us grow spiritually.
This means that we and Bhaiya Ji are elevating our spiritual dimensions together. Whenever we need spiritual energy, we can access it through this connection.
Achieving Siddhis with the Help of Bhaiya Ji

Bhaiya’s Supreme Astral Body will help us in gaining our past life Siddhis. If a person from Ashaeiynn develops enough spiritual strength, they can acquire Bhaiya’s powers, and all the astral bodies connected to him will support them.
Summary

This blog explains how our past lives, astral bodies, and spiritual energies influence our present life. Every person has multiple astral bodies from their past births, and these bodies affect their habits and desires. By resisting past-life habits, one can unlock Siddhis (spiritual powers) and elevate their soul.
Through Surya Vigyan, we learn that:
Our past lives are still connected to us through astral bodies.
We can resist past astral bodies to gain spiritual powers.
The Supreme Astral Body (connected to Lord Hanuman) helps fulfill wishes.
Bhaiya’s astral body guides the members of Ashaeiynn in their spiritual journey.
By understanding and practicing Surya Vigyan, one can achieve higher spiritual dimensions, inner strength, and past life Siddhis to fulfil their true purpose.
